forceMachinationsEventTimeUp :: ArkhamEpicEventId -> Handler ()
forceMachinationsEventTimeUp eid = do
  machinations <- runDB $ ChronicleMachinations.expireMachinations eid
  case machinations of
    Just updates -> for_ updates \(gid, game) -> publishToRoom gid $ GameUpdate $ PublicGame gid (arkhamGameName game) [] (arkhamGameCurrentData game)
    Nothing -> forceNativeEventTimeUp eid
